# Toolchain — what to install, in what order

The advanced bootstrap applies tiers 1–2 by default. Prefer --connect for first use; install only what you need.
Keyed tools require explicit selection with --only or --tier 4 and authorized credentials:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://www.owencoonahan.xyz/design-infra/bootstrap.mjs -o /tmp/di.mjs && node /tmp/di.mjs --connect --client claude-code
node /tmp/di.mjs --list        # ranked list   ·   --tier 3   ·   --only motion,agentation   ·   --dry-run
```

## Tier 1 — Foundation — always

### 1. design-infra (this repo)

The router: ranked catalog, design systems, playbooks, taste memory and the @oc registry. Every other tool is chosen through it. **Use:** Always. plan_ui for pages, propose_options for one component, search_components for pieces.

- registry `@design-infra` → `https://www.owencoonahan.xyz/design-infra/r/{name}.json`
- project MCP `design-infra` (.mcp.json)
- manual: `claude plugin marketplace add OwenCoonahan/design-infra --scope project && claude plugin install design-infra@oc-design --scope project`
- agent note
- agent note
- verify: `curl -sf https://www.owencoonahan.xyz/design-infra/api/setup >/dev/null`

### 2. shadcn/ui CLI + MCP + skill

Every registry (ours, Aceternity, Magic UI, Kibo, Cult UI, React Bits…) installs through it; its MCP browses them all. **Use:** Installing any component; plain app primitives (dialog, select, table, sidebar, chart) come from stock shadcn first.

- project MCP `shadcn` (.mcp.json)
- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add shadcn/ui --skill shadcn -a claude-code codex -y`
- verify: `test -f components.json`

### 3. Motion + @design-infra/motion-presets

The animation engine under ~500 catalog entries; presets keep hand-written motion on the project's motion language. **Use:** Any animation not covered by a drop-in component: layoutId indicators, exits, whileInView, scroll-linked, springs.

- package `motion`
- `npx shadcn@latest add @design-infra/motion-presets`
- agent note
- verify: `node -e "require.resolve('motion')"`

### 4. Motion AI Kit (skill + docs MCP)

Motion's own free skill (best practices, perf, a11y) + docs search MCP. design-infra decides WHAT; this knows HOW. **Use:** Whenever an agent writes Motion code.

- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add motiondivision/ai-kit --skill motion -a claude-code codex -y`
- project MCP `motion` (.mcp.json)
- verify: `test -e .claude/skills/motion || test -e .agents/skills/motion`

## Tier 2 — Default libraries

### 5. Magic UI

Polished, mostly token-friendly animated components (marquee, blur-fade, number-ticker, border-beam); MIT; best free source of tasteful motion. **Use:** Landing-page polish, text/number animation, subtle wrappers.

- registry `@magicui` → `https://magicui.design/r/{name}.json`
- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add magicuidesign/magicui -a claude-code codex -y`
- verify: `test -e .claude/skills/magic-ui || test -e .agents/skills/magic-ui`

### 6. SmoothUI

~230 MIT motion components + blocks on shadcn tokens with the best free AI/agent set (approval, tool call, task list, reasoning) and reduced-motion handling in most items. **Use:** AI/agent surfaces; tabs, scroll-aware navbar, skeletons, carousels and reading progress. Set --brand: var(--primary) once (its tokens.json defaults to pink).

- registry `@smoothui` → `https://smoothui.dev/r/{name}.json`
- agent note

### 7. Motion Primitives

Unstyled Motion wrappers (in-view, text-effect, transition-panel, animated-background) — safest way to add motion to YOUR components. **Use:** 'Animate this' on existing components; tabs/panels/lists/headlines.

- registry `@motion-primitives` → `https://motion-primitives.com/c/{name}.json`

### 8. transitions.dev (skill + MCP)

Tuned CSS micro-interaction recipes applied to your markup (modal, tabs, toast, number pop, success check); free tier is plenty. **Use:** Polish passes: press/hover, open/close timing, state feedback — zero dependencies.

- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add Jakubantalik/transitions.dev --skill transitions-dev transitions-polish -a claude-code codex -y`
- project MCP `transitions` (.mcp.json)
- verify: `test -e .claude/skills/transitions-dev || test -e .agents/skills/transitions-dev`

### 9. Origin UI (coss origin)

~600 theme-aware app components (inputs, tables, calendars, navbars) — the best free source for product UI that just follows the theme. **Use:** App UI variants beyond stock shadcn: fields, filters, data tables, date pickers, command menus.

- agent note

### 10. Aceternity UI (free)

The most-used flashy marketing components (spotlights, beams, scroll effects) — but hard-coded colours and 174 Pro-only blocks. **Use:** Hero/background/scroll moments on marketing pages; convert colours to tokens after install. Free components only.

- registry `@aceternity` → `https://ui.aceternity.com/registry/{name}.json`

### 11. Agentation (visual feedback)

Click any element in the running app, annotate it, and the agent gets selector + source file — the fastest 'fix THIS' loop. **Use:** Design review of a running UI; pairs with the refine skill.

- dev package `agentation`
- project MCP `agentation` (.mcp.json)
- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add benjitaylor/agentation --skill agentation -a claude-code codex -y`
- agent note
- verify: `node -e "require.resolve('agentation')"`

### 12. Jakub Krehel's interface skills

Precise polish rules with exact values (press scale 0.96, enter/exit timings, concentric radii, shadow rings instead of decorative borders, text wrapping, tabular numbers, OKLCH colour, focus and reduced motion). They complement design-infra: we choose WHAT to build, these tighten HOW it renders. MIT, ~8.9k stars. **Use:** After a component or page is chosen and built, for the polish pass: better-ui (surfaces, icons, motion), better-typography, better-colors, better-accessibility, better-layout. Optional skills from the same repo, added on request with --skill <name>: interface-review, explain-interface, variant, teardown, state-machine, build-design, break, better-writing, better-interface. For OKLCH palettes add jakubkrehel/oklch-skill (separate repo). A project's DESIGN.md wins where a rule conflicts with its design system.

- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add jakubkrehel/skills --skill better-ui better-typography better-colors better-accessibility better-layout -a claude-code codex -y`
- agent note
- verify: `test -e .agents/skills/better-ui || test -e .claude/skills/better-ui`

### 13. Kage (design reference MCP)

Free, keyless MCP over 372 analysed real product designs and 1,978 extracted components with prompts — how real products solved a section, beyond our catalog. **Use:** Researching a page or section ('fintech pricing pages', 'a site like Linear for X') before planning; never for bulk export.

- project MCP `kage` (.mcp.json)
- agent note
- verify: `curl -sf -X POST https://kage.design/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"verify","version":"0"}}}' >/dev/null`

## Tier 3 — Situational

### 14. Kibo UI

Complex theme-aware product components (kanban, gantt, editor, dropzone, color picker) you'd never hand-build. **Use:** Rich app features; its hosted MCP is currently broken (HTTP 500) — use the shadcn MCP instead.

- registry `@kibo-ui` → `https://www.kibo-ui.com/r/{name}.json`

### 15. Cult UI

Playful, tactile components and onboarding flows; theming varies by generation. **Use:** Consumer/playful projects (lively motion); check colours after install.

- registry `@cult-ui` → `https://www.cult-ui.com/r/{name}.json`

### 16. React Bits

The deepest well of creative text effects, WebGL backgrounds and micro-interactions — heavy deps, purple defaults, Commons Clause (install-only). **Use:** Cinematic/experimental pages. Names are case-sensitive: @react-bits/SplitText-TS-TW.

- registry `@react-bits` → `https://reactbits.dev/r/{name}.json`

### 17. Beautiful UI

The best free AI/agent surfaces (thinking traces, approvals, tool chips) — its foundation.css redefines --accent. **Use:** AI products; import foundation.css BEFORE your theme or rename its accent vars.

- registry `@beautifui` → `https://www.beautifului.dev/r/{name}.json`

### 18. libraries.dev packages

Small MIT npm packages for AI interfaces: thinking-orbs, border-beam, voice-glow, bot-avatars, metal-fx. **Use:** Install per need (e.g. pnpm add thinking-orbs) — @design-infra/agent-status and @design-infra/beam-card wrap two of them.


### 19. 21st.dev (CLI + MCP)

Breadth: 12k+ community components and search when nothing curated fits. Quality varies. **Use:** Searching for something specific the catalog lacks; read the code before shipping.

- registry `@21st` → `https://21st.dev/r/{name}`
- user MCP `21st`: `claude mcp add -s user --transport http 21st https://21st.dev/api/mcp -H "x-api-key: ${API_KEY_21ST}"`
- secret `API_KEY_21ST` — get it at https://21st.dev/settings/api-keys (free account; component code is metered)
- verify: `npx -y @21st-dev/cli@latest whoami`

### 20. Kitbitz (CC0 illustrations MCP)

2,043 hand-drawn CC0 illustrations in 13 consistent kits, searchable through a free read-only MCP — warmth for empty states and onboarding without an illustrator. **Use:** Empty states, onboarding, 404s and marketing spots on warm/playful products; download the chosen SVGs into the project.

- project MCP `kitbitz` (.mcp.json)
- agent note
- verify: `curl -sf -X POST https://mcp.kitbitz.art -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"verify","version":"0"}}}' >/dev/null`

### 24. Anatomy (isometric explainer skill)

Specialist illustration tool for interactive explanations of mechanisms and technical concepts; the catalog supplies reusable anatomy-figures components first. **Use:** Docs, educational articles and technical feature sections that need an explanatory SVG or WebGL figure. Select explicitly; ordinary controls use component libraries.

- run: `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx -y skills@latest add wheresryan22/anatomy --skill anatomy -a claude-code codex -y`
- agent note
- verify: `test -f .agents/skills/anatomy/SKILL.md`

### 25. beUI (free)

Free animated controls, charts and agent surfaces with a public MIT registry. Separate from Beautiful UI and the paid beUI Pro collection. **Use:** Choose compatible React 19/Tailwind 4 components as needed. Preserve the project theme; map missing surface tokens. Pro stays opt-in until licensed access is confirmed.

- registry `@beui` → `https://beui.dev/r/{name}.json`

## Tier 4 — Paid / metered / keyed

### 21. OriginKit (CLI + MCP)

~1,100 WebGL/shader backgrounds, heroes and cursors — the wow factor, metered and proprietary. **Use:** A signature background/hero when the free catalog looks too familiar.

- user MCP `originkit`: `claude mcp add -s user --transport http originkit https://mcp.originkit.dev/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ORIGINKIT_API_KEY}"`
- agent note
- secret `ORIGINKIT_API_KEY` — get it at https://www.originkit.dev (Profile → API Keys; free = 10 copies/day, Pro $79/yr)
- verify: `npx -y originkit@latest whoami`

### 22. Motion+ (premium components + MCP)

Carousel, Ticker, AnimateNumber, Typewriter, Cursor, page transitions and all 460+ example sources. **Use:** Only with a licence; then prefer it over hand-rolled versions of those components.

- project MCP `motion-plus` (.mcp.json)
- agent note
- secret `MOTION_PLUS` — get it at https://motion.dev/plus (set MOTION_PLUS=1 once you have a membership; the MCP signs in via OAuth in /mcp)

### 23. transitions.dev Pro

React/TS variants of every recipe plus Pro transitions. **Use:** When CSS recipes need to become typed React components.

- user MCP `transitions-pro`: `claude mcp add -s user --transport http transitions-pro https://api.transitions.dev/v1/agent/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TRANSITIONS_LICENSE}"`
- secret `TRANSITIONS_LICENSE` — get it at https://transitions.dev (Pro $9/mo or $149 lifetime)
